title: Ninety years of pulse oximetry: history, current status, and outlook
lineage: Full open-access review; a retrospective account, not the original 1975 Japanese patient paper. Earlier ear oximeters and independently developed Minolta work are preserved.

passages.note: 1958 Wood trace; Aoyagi ratio and prototype; spring 1974 Nakajima patient pilot; 1973–1977 Minolta/Nihon Kohden; 1982 Nellcor sales.
